rationale: Mechanism-v2 and v3 returned NO-GO on the within-parent intervention-ranking estimand. Measured cause: within-decision outcome reliability 0.239 against a leaky ceiling of +0.0218 rank gain. Mechanism-v4 changes the estimand, not the gates' strictness: it asks whether absolute subcellular localization is predictable from sequence, which is the estimand whose measurement reliability is adequate.

measured_reliability_justification.note: tdp43 carries no usable effect_uncertainty and is therefore excluded from v4 scoring.

primary_source_reason: Only source whose outcome_semantics is an absolute per-sequence measure ('author WT-normalized log2 neurite enrichment') with usable uncertainty. Mikl and TDP43 outcomes in the certified table are already mutant-minus-WT differences and therefore re-pose the failed estimand.

label_definition.binary: significant neurite enrichment: localization_effect > 0 AND (localization_effect / effect_uncertainty) >= 1.96, versus all others
label_definition.binary_reason: Matches the published definition used by the Mikl source paper (significant enrichment versus all others), so reported auROC is comparable to its 0.81-0.83.

T1_within_parent_design.question: Given deep mutagenesis of a 3'UTR, can sequence features predict the absolute localization of unseen variants of that same 3'UTR?
T1_within_parent_design.split: stratified 5-fold over sequences, within each gene, seeded
T1_within_parent_design.practical_meaning: supports sequence-level design of localization elements in a known context

T2_cross_parent_zero_shot.question: Does a model trained on some genes predict localization for sequences from entirely unseen genes?
T2_cross_parent_zero_shot.split: frozen biological_fold, grouped by group_id; no component may straddle train and test
T2_cross_parent_zero_shot.practical_meaning: this is the actual universal RNAddress claim
T2_cross_parent_zero_shot.acknowledged_weakness: only 10 independent genes exist in this source, so T2 has 5 grouped folds over few units and low power. A T2 failure here is therefore weaker evidence than the v2 failure was, and must be reported as inconclusive-or-negative, never as proof of impossibility.

features.primary: counts of all k-mers for k in [1,2,3,4,5], 1364 columns, on ACGT-normalized sequence
features.composition_control: counts of all k-mers for k in [1,2] only, 20 columns

gates.g1_t1_predictive: T1 mean auROC >= 0.80 AND T1 mean Spearman >= 0.50
gates.g2_t1_beats_composition: T1 mean auROC exceeds composition_control mean auROC by >= 0.030
gates.g6_t2_beats_composition: T2 mean auROC exceeds composition_control mean auROC by >= 0.030
gates.g7_seed_stability: standard deviation of T2 mean auROC across seeds <= 0.020
gates.g8_split_integrity: no group_id appears in both train and test for any scored split

verdict_rules.STRONG GO - UNIVERSAL ZERO-SHOT RNADDRES: g1-g9 all pass AND the one-time Astrocyte confirmation passes after a committed pre-holdout freeze
verdict_rules.PARTIAL GO - RESTRICTED ZERO-SHOT DOMAIN: g1, g2, g3, g8, g9 pass but T2 gates fail; claim is restricted to within-parent sequence design and must say so explicitly

prior_exposure_disclosure: Moffatt absolute outcomes contributed to the paired regret and rank metrics examined during Mechanism-v2 and v3. They are therefore not pristine, although they were never examined under a sequence-level classification estimand. Development results alone can never be a STRONG GO. The sealed Astrocyte holdout remains the only uncontaminated confirmation.
stopping_rule: Mechanism-v4 is scored exactly once per seed. No gate, threshold, feature set, split, label definition or estimator may change after any score is observed. If the gates fail, v4 closes.
preserved_conclusions: FinalShot 98ffc02: NO-GO - END ZERO-SHOT RNADDRESS, unchanged
boundaries_unchanged: quarantined TDP EV5 stability data never accessed
Astrocyte sealed; open_holdout refuses unconditionally during development
only tests/mechanism_v4 and tests/mechanism_v2 are run
